numeric_target_author: Implementation team; operationalization, not an owner-supplied number
initial_hp_derivation: 1 + first digest byte modulo8 of SHA256('mortal-balance/1.0.0|initial-hp|' + phase + '|' + index); separate fixture domain, not action RNG
secondary_stress: Two identical foes, classic d8/armor11, all three policies; separate cells, never pooled into primary

analysis.descriptive_intervals: 95% Wilson binomial; paired improved-minus-worsened from union-bounded Wilson marginals with four tails of .0125 (z2.241402727604947)
analysis.confirmatory_intervals: Four one-sided target bounds at alpha=.05/4; danger/escape z2.241402727604947. Paired lower splits its .0125 budget over two marginal tails of .00625 each (z2.497705474412373); upper constructed analogously.
analysis.coverage_limit: Conservative union construction without marginal independence; Wilson score coverage is nominal, not an exact finite-sample guarantee.
analysis.censored_comparison: Any pair censored in either relevant arm forces target inconclusive in train and holdout; no paired terminal-survival interval is computed.

selection: Training: retain classic if all adjusted target intervals match; otherwise floor4 only if all its intervals match; otherwise no-target-match. Any combat censorship prevents recommendation. Heldout never selects or retunes.
exclusions: No rows dropped, no seed replacement, no automatic repeat/pursuit, no live models, no state patches, no journal/signature assurance from pure replay
after_holdout_change: Keep all results; a changed rule/configuration requires a newly preregistered protocol/seed domain. Do not call the exposed holdout fresh evidence.
method_revision_note: Pre-study independent review M01/M02/M03: paired union-bounded score intervals, censored comparisons inconclusive, full compact seed rows. Seed domains and encounter matrix unchanged.
retention: All combat and resource per-seed outcomes, counts, state/transition/replay hashes are retained as compact column arrays; full rows reconstruct integer_results_digest.
